title: Choose the Visual Direction for TALA
question: The roll assigned Candidate #6: The Philippine Archival Collegiate Registry. Review the assigned direction, competitors, and canon, then confirm your choice.

options.label: The Philippine Archival Collegiate Registry
options.lineage: Philippine collegiate registry folios and archival institutional ledgers
options.thesis: An authoritative, dignified institutional workbench pairing archival collegiate structure with high-assurance operational controls.
options.viewport: Servitech Institute Asia Inc. institutional banner leads with authoritative insignia; below, high-density enrollment recovery and timetable conflict consoles display immediate actionable statuses with zero modal friction.
options.risk: Can feel overly formal if interactive micro-states lack responsive tactile feedback.

raised.raise: CP-SAT solver and background jobs gain an embedded live audit stream drawer with high-legibility telemetry.
Structural academic terms and curriculum packages use continuous structural hierarchy brackets.

options.label: The Registrar's Certified Record Folio
options.lineage: Official CHED Form 137, permanent record cards, and dry-sealed transcripts
options.thesis: Every operational screen feels like an authentic, certified collegiate record card with laser-sharp tabular discipline.
options.viewport: Structured header with institutional seal watermark, followed by two-column dual-ledger view of active registration cases and class schedule matrices.
options.risk: The most familiar pattern in institutional collegiate administration; highly conventional.

options.label: High-Density Operational Mosaic
options.thesis: A dense mosaic of ruled rectangular modules, packed edge-to-edge with utility tabs, eliminating wasted administrative whitespace.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge modular dashboard packing timetable conflict matrix, reservation expiry countdowns, and payment queues into a single zero-scroll viewport.
options.case: Exceptional data density and scanability for high-volume registrar work; loses slightly on collegiate institutional warmth.
options.risk: High visual density can overwhelm casual or infrequent users.

options.label: Signals Instrument Terminal
options.case: Lacks collegiate institutional identity; registrar staff do not identify with hacker consoles.
options.kept: High-legibility telemetry audit trail stream for CP-SAT solver and background queues.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.case: Pop-culture sci-fi aesthetics conflict with Philippine higher education authority.
options.kept: Continuous structural hierarchy brackets connecting academic term packages to section offerings.

canonCard.label: The SaaS Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: Standard enterprise education ERP admin portal (floating white cards, neutral slate borders, primary blue actions).
canonCard.viewport: Standard top navigation, metric stat cards, and standard paginated data tables with action dropdowns.
canonCard.risk: Completely indistinguishable from generic SaaS templates; lacks distinct institutional presence.
